question.text: Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund (Cat III AIF) has completed 14 months since First Close. As per SEBI's operational guidelines on performance benchmarking, on what frequency and reference dates must the Manager report performance data to the benchmarking agency?

answer.text: Monthly, on the last day of every month
Half-yearly, as on 30-September and 31-March each year

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI operational guidelines (Box 8.6, Section A): 'Performance Benchmarking shall be done on a half-yearly basis based on the data as on September 30 and March 31 of each year.' Data for 31-March must be AUDITED; 30-September data may be unaudited. The Trap: Monthly (A) is too frequent; quarterly (B) is the wrong cycle; annual (D) misses the unaudited Sep-30 reporting point. Only half-yearly on Sep-30 and Mar-31 is correct for benchmarking. Note: Audited March data is reported within the SEBI-prescribed valuation-reporting timeline (7 months), which is what makes the half-yearly cycle workable.
